scheme_name: Indo-French Visiting/Mobility Programme for Women in Science
other_conditions: Applicants must be Indian or French citizens (citizens residing in France)
Applicants must be from a recognized university or research institution in India or France
Indian applicants must hold a PhD degree and a sanctioned/tenured post in a scientific/academic institution
French applicants must hold a PhD degree and be currently completing a postdoctoral project
Applicants must be willing to undertake collaborative research projects in the partner country’s institutions/universities
The mobility must occur during the applicant’s employment period at the concerned institution
Applicants must not have availed any visiting fellowship in France/India during the last 5 years
The fellowship cannot be availed simultaneously with any other fellowship
Preference is given to candidates with no prior international exposure
CEFIPRA may relax eligibility conditions for potential candidates
benefits_summary: Provides return economy airfare, accommodation, per diem allowances, local travel, airport transfer, insurance and visa charges for selected candidates.
